description: This file contains multiple Data Transfer Object (DTO) classes related to recipes and authentication for a recipe management backend system. It defines structures for creating, updating, responding with recipe data, as well as for user registration and login.

classes.name: RecipeCreateDto
classes.description: DTO for creating a new recipe, includes title, description, ingredients, and tags.

classes.name: RecipeUpdateDto
classes.description: DTO for updating an existing recipe, includes fields similar to creation DTO.

classes.name: RecipeResponseDto
classes.description: DTO used for returning detailed recipe information, including metadata like Id, timestamps, author, along with recipe data.

classes.name: RecipeQuery
classes.description: DTO for querying recipes with optional filters such as query string, ingredient, tag, and pagination parameters.

classes.name: RegisterRequest
classes.description: DTO for user registration containing username and password with validation constraints.

classes.name: LoginRequest
classes.description: DTO for user login containing username and password.

classes.name: AuthResponse
classes.description: DTO for authentication response containing token and username.
